titleEn: Split It in Half—Two Streams of Steam!

pages.text: "I will eat all of this!" Nils the little bear hugged a baked potato in both paws. It was the last potato on the plate. Grandpa Bruno opened the door, returning from gathering firewood.
"Nils, Grandpa is hungry too." Grandpa brushed off fallen leaves and sat by the stove. "No! There is only one!" Nils hugged the potato and turned his back.
Sitting alone, Nils bit into the potato. Only chewing sounds filled the quiet cabin. "...Eating alone is boring." He stopped chewing.
Grandpa sat beside him. "You have the whole potato, but where has your smile gone?" Nils tilted his head. "It is big... but I keep looking at you."
Grandpa took the potato and split it in half on his broad palm. Two white streams of steam rose. "Look. One stream of steam has become two!"
"Split it in half—two streams of steam!" Nils called, watching them. Grandpa put one half in his paw. They blew gently, and the two streams swayed side by side.
"Grandpa, let us eat together!" Nils took a bite of his half. Grandpa took a bite too. The fluffy potato melted in their mouths. Eating face to face made them keep smiling.
Only peels remained on the plate. "It was half, but my tummy feels fuller." Nils patted his belly. Grandpa laughed heartily, and the stove flames flickered.

The next morning, Nils split a piece of bread in half. "One, split it in half! Two, share one half each! Three, blow on it together!" Two streams of steam rose again from the split. "Split it in half—two streams of steam!"
"This is yours, Grandpa!" Nils offered a half. Grandpa sat him on his lap, and Nils raised his paws. Sharing makes two, not just a half. "Split it in half—two streams of steam!"
